title: Forming fact-finding panel by agitating students unauthorised, aimed at fomenting tension: SRFTI

ai.summary: SRFTI authorities claim a student-led fact-finding panel is unauthorized and aims to distort facts and undermine the ongoing SIT probe into campus violence since September 27.

facts.claim: SRFTI authorities said an independent fact-finding exercise initiated by a group of protesting students into the campus crisis was 'unauthorised'
facts.quote: SRFTI authorities said an independent fact-finding exercise initiated by a group of protesting students into the campus crisis was “unauthorised”, claiming that such an attempt was aimed at “distorting the factual record, fomenting tension and undermining the ongoing SIT probe”.

facts.claim: The SRFTI said several incidents, including alleged attacks on students, since September 27 have been investigated by a special investigation team
facts.quote: The Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, said several incidents, including alleged attacks on students, since September 27 have been investigated by a special investigation team constituted by the West Bengal government, and questioned the legitimacy of a “parallel probe by an external organisation”.

facts.claim: SRFTI Registrar Deepak Kumar said the institute had also constituted its own fact-finding committee
facts.quote: SRFTI Registrar Deepak Kumar said on Thursday night that the institute had also constituted its own fact-finding committee to inquire into alleged violence on the campus.

facts.claim: The institute has been witnessing protests since September 27 following alleged attacks on students during an RSS-linked Akhil Bharatiya Grahak Panchayat event on the campus
facts.quote: The institute has been witnessing protests since September 27 following alleged attacks on students during an RSS-linked Akhil Bharatiya Grahak Panchayat event on the campus.

facts.claim: The stir intensified after a second alleged attack on October 4 during a rally by Bangiya Hindu Jagran Manch
facts.quote: The stir intensified after a second alleged attack on October 4 during a rally by Bangiya Hindu Jagran Manch, with students organising sit-ins and raising concerns over their safety, privacy and freedom of movement.

facts.claim: The situation deteriorated following an October 15 incident involving Vice Chancellor Santosh Ajmera
facts.quote: The situation deteriorated following an October 15 incident involving Vice Chancellor Santosh Ajmera. The SRFTI administration accused a group of students of gheraoing and manhandling the VC and vandalising his office.

ai.background_note: SRFTI students have been protesting since September 27 over alleged attacks on students during an RSS-linked event, with tensions escalating through October 15 when the VC was allegedly assaulted.
